authorization.interpretedScope: Authorize the frozen V4 P1/P2 development run exactly as specified in the immediately preceding CURRENT_STATE.md gate.

authorizedActions: verify frozen V4 identities before P1/P2 media access
reconstruct the exact frozen P1/P2 development population
execute the two serialized V4 development folds with resumable boundaries 400->800->1000
evaluate with the frozen V4 decoder
emit final fold artifacts only at epoch 1000
perform structural admission and unchanged frozen development metric evaluation after both final fold artifacts exist

outcomeRule.ifEitherFoldFails: Freeze V4 development FAIL; diagnose P1/P2 only; no threshold rescue.
outcomeRule.ifBothFoldsPass: Record only eligible for separate P3 authorization; do not open P3 automatically.
